name: build-visionos-apps
description: Build visionOS apps with workflows for windows, volumes, and immersive spaces, RealityKit 3D content, Reality Composer Pro scenes, spatial gestures, and simulator/device build-run-debug.

interface.shortDescription: Build, refine, and debug visionOS apps with spaces, RealityKit, and Xcode workflows
interface.longDescription: Use Build visionOS Apps to choose between windows, volumes, and immersive spaces, build and refactor SwiftUI scenes for spatial computing, load and compose RealityKit entities and USDZ content, author scenes with Reality Composer Pro, wire spatial tap/drag/rotate/magnify gestures and hover effects, and build, run, and debug apps on the visionOS Simulator or Apple Vision Pro with XcodeBuildMCP-backed workflows.
defaultPrompt: Build or debug a visionOS app with SwiftUI scenes, RealityKit content, and the visionOS Simulator.
